facts.fact: 第三试简报：考验空间记忆/地形/效率/导航；带一名非 Guard「累赘」（High Council 指定——她的是 Draven！Warret=怀孕妻子、Ryger=14 岁弟弟、Alden=Evelyn 公主——他的恋情首次曝光）；「The cost of failure will be personal」
facts.anchor: The High Council chose those most central to your lives

facts.fact: 她的定格句：我的 Marked 就是我的个人累赘；「The stakes have changed.」——Alden 与她互稳（「On the other side?」「After me.」）
facts.anchor: My Marked is my personal liability.

facts.fact: Ryger 挑衅偏袒——她当众驳回（「Draven 非 Guard、你配的是你弟弟」「Your brother is a year older than me when I joined the Guard!」）；Warret 助攻（「Alden got the princess, and you didn't hear him bitching—and I got my pregnant wife」）；Lucan 挺她——她不领情（Rigged. Fucking rigged.——对 Lucan 的怒仍在）
facts.anchor: It is fair,” I say, loud enough for everyone to hear.

facts.fact: 溪边交底：向 Icarus 披露 Draven 的听觉血赋+Marked 关系（此前只有 Lucan/Alden 知）——「若我因此妥协，你有权以完全透明挑战我的判断」；Icarus 惊叹 Cadmarian 缘分
facts.anchor: If it compromises me at all, I want you to know so you can challenge my judgment

facts.fact: Draven 的承诺+她的别扭：他问「你还好吗」——「No. 但庆幸你是个资源」；「Commander?」「Lavina. I am no commander of yours」；种马把头搁他肩上呼气；「I liked it when you claimed me as your Marked Match」
出发：地图看完即烧（Alden 不到一分钟——Mnesic 优势、两人心照 Rigged）；目的地=最南聚落 Wentor 的 Guard 站（她早年驻守一年）；路线选沿 Vine 平行（更长但匀速的赌注）；原班六人+Speckle 战结
facts.anchor: We ride south for the command post Wentor
